label: Town of Cornwall
header:
# Town of Cornwall municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Cornwall Selectboard members: Tanya Byker (Chair), Don Burns (Vice Chair), Barbara Greenwood, Brian Kemp, and John Roberts.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists the board before the 2026 meeting as Byker, Burns, Kemp, Roberts, and Shawn Fetterolf.

Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Brian Kemp as the only candidate for the 3-year seat and Shawn Fetterolf and Barbara Greenwood for the 2-year seat; the Secretary of State directory seats Greenwood, establishing that she won the 2-year seat. No official tally for the March 3, 2026 ballot is posted on the town's website.
Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists the Moderator as Cy Day Tall.
Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Cy Day Tall as the only candidate for Moderator (1-year term) at the March 3, 2026 meeting.

Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Laura Fetterolf as the only candidate 'For Town Clerk, For 3 Years' at the March 3, 2026 meeting -- the first election for the office after the March 2025 meeting voted (Article 8) to return the clerkship from appointed to elected for a 3-year term starting Town Meeting 2026.

Town of Cornwall, approved Town Meeting Minutes of February 28, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): the minutes are submitted by Laura Fetterolf as Town Clerk; the 2025 Town Report's appointed officers table had listed her as the appointed Town Clerk.
Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Appointed Town Officers 2025' lists the Town Treasurer as Susan Johnson.
Town of Cornwall, approved Town Meeting Minutes of February 28, 2026: 'Sue Johnson has been appointed Treasurer to fulfill the statutorily required position.' The holder is recorded as appointed.
Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists the Delinquent Tax Collector as Nicholas Elder (appointed).

Town of Cornwall, approved Town Meeting Minutes of February 28, 2026: Article 7, moving the Delinquent Tax Collector from elected to an appointed position with a 1-year term, carried; the minutes identify Nicholas Elder (formerly Gill) as the current appointed delinquent tax collector. The holder is recorded as appointed.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists three Listers: Jordan Young (term expiring 2026), William Johnson (2027), and Todd Kincaid (2028).
Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Jordan Young as the only candidate for Lister (3-year term) at the March 3, 2026 meeting.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists three Auditors: Caroline Mellish (term expiring 2026), Ian Gill (2027), and Katie Gieges (2028).

Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): the March 3, 2026 ballot's Auditor contest (3-year term) printed no candidate's name (write-in only), and no official tally is posted; the seat that stood in 2026 is left unfilled.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists three Trustees of Public Funds: David Anderson (appointed; term expiring 2026), Elizabeth Toder (2026), and Magna Dodge (2027).

Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Elizabeth Toder as the only candidate for the 3-year term and David Anderson as the only candidate for the 2-year unexpired term at the March 3, 2026 meeting.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists five Cemetery Commissioners: Anne Collins (term expiring 2026), Janet Franklin (appointed, 2027), Roth 'T' Tall (2028), Jim Pugh (2029), and Sue Johnson (2030).
Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Anne Collins as the only candidate for Cemetery Commissioner (5-year term) at the March 3, 2026 meeting.
Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists the First Constable as Gary Margolis.
Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Gary Margolis as the only candidate for First Constable at the March 3, 2026 meeting.
Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists the Second Constable as Luke Jerome.
Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): prints Luke Jerome as the only candidate for Second Constable at the March 3, 2026 meeting.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists seven Library Trustee seats on 2-year terms: three expiring in 2026 (one printed vacant) and Laura Fetterolf, Rich Isenberg, Patty McCormick, and Kristina Simmons expiring in 2027.

Town of Cornwall, Official Annual Town Meeting Ballot, March 3, 2026 (cornwallvt.gov): the March 3, 2026 ballot warned three Library Trustee seats; the candidates printed (Tobi Andrews, Barbara Kinkead, Amanda Payne) are not recorded as holders because no official tally is posted -- candidates are not winners. The three 2026 seats are left unfilled.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Appointed Town Officers 2025' lists the Road Commissioner as Brian Kemp, with the appointment term expiring in 2026. Structure only: no official source publishes the current appointee; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Cornwall justices of the peace: David Anderson, Marjorie Drexler, Susan Johnson, Gary Margolis, and Jordan Young.

Town of Cornwall, 2025 Town Report (147th Annual Report, year ending December 31, 2025; cornwallvt.gov): 'Elected Town Officers 2025' lists the town's justices of the peace as Marjorie Drexler, Susan Johnson, Gary Margolis, Jordan Young, and Annie Wilson, with two further seats printed vacant -- the town table's variance from the Secretary of State's certified listing is noted; the listing governs the election record.

jp_election.name: Town of Cornwall Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Cornwall justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: David Anderson, Marjorie Drexler, Susan Johnson, Gary Margolis, and Jordan Young. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
